terms: Arkansas Digital Responsibility, Safety, and Trust Act

leads.usedFor: Check for a comprehensive privacy law in Arkansas
Pointer to SB258 of 2025, which failed
Bill status: SB258 died on the Senate calendar at sine die, 5/5/2025
Act 952 of 2025, teen online privacy, effective 2026-07-01; not a health data law

consumer_health_data.note: No comprehensive or consumer health data law found. SB258 of 2025 failed. Act 952 of 2025 covers online data of children and teens, not health data as such, so it was not scored here.

crossCheck.note: Own search: SB258 of 2025 died on the Senate calendar at sine die. Act 952 of 2025, in force 2026-07-01, covers child and teen online data and has no health data term. No other provision found.

feeRules: Paper photocopy cap: "fifty cents (50¢) per page for the first twenty-five (25) pages and twenty-five cents (25¢) for each additional page."
Labor charge up to $25.00 per request plus actual postage (Act 765 of 2023 amended this from $15.00).

Electronic records: "The fee for producing medical records under this subsection is seventy-five dollars ($75.00), and the actual cost of postage, if any postage is required, may be charged in addition to the fee for producing medical records."
Notarized or certified copy: "an additional fee of two dollars ($2.00) may be charged."
Patient's own request follows HIPAA patient access rules as of 2023-01-01, except the HIPAA fee provisions (16-46-106(h)).

copy_rights.note: Deadline is 30 days, not shorter. No free-copy case found. The $75 electronic fee and per-page caps are fee facts only. Nothing goes beyond HIPAA plus the information blocking rule, so beyondFederalFloor is no.

crossCheck.note: beyondFederalFloor: no. Deadline is 30 days, not shorter. Act 765 has no free-copy case. Legislature list shows no 2025 amendment to 16-46-106. Effective 2023-08-01 per Senate page.
